name: member-card
title: MemberCard compound widget — avatar + name + email + role chip + online indicator

public_api.constructor:
MemberCard({
  required MembersEntity member,
  VoidCallback? onTap,
  String? roleLabel,
  Color? roleColor,
  bool showEmail = true,
  bool isOnline = false,
})

conventions_reminder: All colors/spacings/radii via tokens — no hardcoded values except white border on online dot
Double quotes on all string literals
Private _OnlineDot helper class for green dot indicator
acceptance_criteria: Public API: MemberCard({required MembersEntity member, VoidCallback? onTap, String? roleLabel, Color? roleColor, bool showEmail = true, bool isOnline = false})
Shows avatar (AppAvatar, size md) + name + optional email subtitle + optional role chip (AppChip, filled variant) + optional online indicator (green 12px dot with white border)
All spacing via Spacing tokens (space_md, space_sm, space_4xs)
All colors via AppColors tokens (primary, success, textSecondaryLight, Colors.white for border)
completion_summary: Implemented MemberCard compound widget with AppCard base, AppAvatar (size md), name title (Sem nome fallback), optional email subtitle, optional filled AppChip role badge, and optional green online indicator dot (12px, success color, white border)
